invitation_subject: {owner_email} invites you to be a recovery contact | Aeterna Relay
invitation_intro: {owner_email} has invited you to be their recovery contact in Aeterna Relay.
about_text: Aeterna Relay is a personal library app that encrypts and stores personal information and documents on the user's own device.
role_heading: What does a recovery contact do?
role_text: A recovery contact is someone the owner trusts to receive recovery notifications and help with recovery when authorized. This invitation asks whether you are willing to take that role.
choice_text: You can accept or decline on the invitation page. Accepting verifies control of this mailbox and records your agreement. It does not give you immediate access to the owner's library or recovery material, create an account, or require a password.
privacy_text: This invitation includes no private message, library content, or recovery material.
expiry_text: Invitation links are valid for 7 days after creation. This link expires at {expires_at} (UTC). If it has expired, ask the inviter to send a new invitation.
security_text: If you do not recognize {owner_email}, do not accept. Confirm with them using a contact method you already trust, or decline on the invitation page.
fallback_label: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
footer_text: Aeterna Relay sent this service email on behalf of {owner_email} because they selected this address as a recovery contact.
test_subject: Aeterna Relay recovery contact delivery test
test_text: This is a delivery test for a recovery-contact role that this email address previously accepted and verified.
claim_subject: Aeterna Relay recovery access is available
claim_text: Recovery access is available to this verified recovery contact. Open Aeterna on the computer that holds the Vault and paste this email link into Emergency recovery. The app will send a separate mailbox verification code, valid for 10 minutes. The entry link can be used again while this recovery remains authorized.
otp_text:
Use this one-time code to continue the delayed-recovery claim: {code}

The code expires in 10 minutes.
security_notice_text: Another verified recovery contact completed a one-time recovery-secret claim for this Aeterna Relay account.
